summary: Episodes 54-59 are six consecutive canon rows adapting manga chapters 193-217 (vols 21-24) in strict running order — no filler, no skips, no reordering, no recap segment: Hadlar's black core and Baran's last stand (54-55), Baran's death and Dai inheriting his heart (56), the first Vearn fight (57-58), the survivors regrouping at Carl (59). Every chapter number below is stated in OUR chapter space (en-WP's original-release volume list = our stored v1-v37 boundary table = AniList's and MangaDex's 349), and the conversion off dragonquest.fandom's numbering is stated per anchor. THE CONVERSION IS NOT A CONSTANT, and that is this sub-block's finding. The coordinator's mid-task correction — ours = fandom + 1 for every fandom N >= 122, because our slot 122 is the 番外編「勇者アバン」 that the fandom does not number — is CONFIRMED for our ch 123-207 and applied here (eps 54, 55, 56 and the opening of ep 57). It BREAKS at our ch 208: the fandom gains one number back there, so from our 208 to the end its numbers equal ours, and eps 58 and 59 take the fandom's numbers unchanged. Three legs prove it. (1) Arithmetic on the fandom's own fields: its per-episode values run CONTIGUOUSLY from 187 at ep 53 to 349 at ep 100 with no gap and no repeat (its ep 61 is the side story, labelled 'Special chapter', unnumbered) — 163 numbers for our 162 chapters 188-349, an exact surplus of one; a uniform +1 would send ep 100 to a chapter 350 that does not exist. (2) Our space's ONLY unnumbered extra anywhere in that span is 大魔宮の秘密 at the end of tankōbon v22, i.e. between our 207 and 208 — the fandom evidently numbers it 207. (3) Toei Animation's own per-episode あらすじ: ep 57 ends on 'ダイが再び立ち上がる！' (ch 209 不屈の勇者・ダイ!!!, the fandom's '209 (1 panel)') and ep 58 opens on the Avan Strash that follows (ch 209 again, the fandom's '209') — both in OUR numbering, unconverted. The same Toei text quotes chapter titles almost verbatim below the seam too (ep 56 closes on 大魔王からの褒美 = our 205 'Vearn's Reward'; ep 57 covers 次元の違い = our 206), which is what fixes the offset on the low side and rules out a no-offset reading. Batch 17's eps 1-17 (ch 1-60) sit entirely below the divergence and need no repair.

structure.notes: CHAPTER SPACE — the sub-block's main finding, series-wide, and a correction to the coordinator's mid-task instruction. OUR space = en-WP's 'Original release' volume list, which reproduces our stored v1-v37 boundaries exactly (v1 1-9 … v13 114-122, v14 123-132, v20 180-189, v21 190-198, v22 199-207, v23 208-216, v24 217-226 … v37 342-349) and whose ceiling 349 = AniList's and MangaDex's count. dragonquest.fandom does NOT number the 番外編「勇者アバン」 printed at the back of tankōbon v13 (our slot 122; the fandom's ep-61 field calls it 'Special chapter', unnumbered), so its numbers run ONE LOW from our 123 決勝戦の異変!! — proven title-for-title on the six consecutive chapters whose fandom pages still exist (fandom 190 ハドラー不敵な挑戦! = ours 191; 191 決意の先陣!! = 192; 192 爆弾を抱えた魔王 = 193; 193 攻撃不能...!? = 194; 194 超激突の明暗 = 195; 195 血の罠 = 196; 196 さらば我が子よ = 197), and by the fandom's own per-chapter |volume= fields, which land on our boundaries only under the +1. The fandom's chapter pages STOP at its 196, and the offset is NOT constant above it: it CLOSES at our ch 208, after which the fandom's numbers ARE ours. Proof, three legs. (1) ARITHMETIC ON THE FANDOM'S OWN FIELDS: eps 53-100 carry a strictly contiguous run of numbers, 187 at ep 53 through 349 at ep 100, with no gap and no repeat (verified field by field; the only non-numeric row is ep 61's side story) — that is 163 numbers against our 162 chapters 188-349, a surplus of exactly one. A uniform +1 would put ep 100 at 347-350 and there is no chapter 350. (2) THE ONLY UNNUMBERED EXTRA in our space anywhere in that span is 大魔宮の秘密 at the end of tankōbon v22, between our 207 and 208 (our list carries four unnumbered extras in total — the v13 side story, two v18 info pages, and this one; the v18 pair is excluded because the offset is still -1 at our 191-197, far above them). So the fandom's 207 is that extra, and the surplus is spent exactly there. (3) LICENSOR CONTENT ACROSS THE SEAM: Toei's ep-57 synopsis ends on 'ダイが再び立ち上がる！' — ch 209 不屈の勇者・ダイ!!!, matching the fandom's oddly precise '209 (1 panel)' in OUR numbering — and its ep-58 synopsis opens on the Avan Strash that follows, matching the fandom's '209' as ep 58's START. Under a uniform +1 that panel would be ch 210 恐怖の切り札 (Bahn's 光魔の杖), which Toei introduces as new material in ep 58, and ch 209 would sit whole inside ep 57 whose synopsis never mentions the Strash at all. Below the seam the same instrument fixes the +1 (ep 56 ends on 大魔王からの褒美 = our 205; ep 57 covers 次元の違い = our 206), and rules out a no-offset reading, which would push さらば我が子よ and 大魔王からの褒美 an episode late against Toei. NOTE also that en-WP and MangaDex disagree about WHERE the side story sits — en-WP leaves slot 122 at the end of v13, MangaDex numbers it 118 and shifts 119-122 — a purely local four-chapter difference at 118-121 where our space and the fandom both follow en-WP; above 122 en-WP and MangaDex agree with each other and with us. PER-EPISODE MAP (our space | the fandom's field verbatim): 54 = 193(tail),194-197 | '192 (partial), 193, 194, 195, 196'; 55 = 198-201 | '197, 198, 199, 200'; 56 = 202-204, 205(partial) | '201, 202, 203, 204 (partial)'; 57 = 205(bulk),206-208, 209(1 panel) | '204 (partial), 205, 206, 207, 208, 209 (1 panel)'; 58 = 209(bulk),210-212, 213(partial) | '209, 210, 211, 212, 213 (partial)'; 59 = 213(tail),214-216, 217(partial) | '213 (partial), 214, 215, 216, 217 (partial)'. Ep 60 opens on ch 217's closing pages and runs 218, 219, 220 (partial) in OUR space — its fandom field needs NO conversion — so wave 14 should give ep 60 START 218 (Toei has ep 60 begin by stating the execution notice's content = 218 処刑宣告の罠!!!, then Dai leaving the front line = 219, then the army reuniting = 220) with a 217 tail. Wave 14 should also note that ep 61 adapts our ch 122, the 番外編 itself, out of running order. ENDs here are monotone 197 → 201 → 205 → 208 → 213 → 217, inside the run's fence (ep 17 → 60 below, ep 100 → 349 above). ROW IDENTITY: ja-WP's 各話リスト（2020） confirms all six titles and air dates (54 10/23, 55 10/30, 56 11/6, 57 11/13, 58 11/20, 59 11/27, 2021) against our stored rows — no numbering or date defect; that table has no 原作 column, so it is a title/date witness only. STANDINGS: no filler, no anime-original material and no recap segment anywhere in 54-59; the fandom's 'Manga differences' sections for all six are empty (ep 53's is not, and lists only cosmetic changes) — all six stay canon.

flags_for_sean: CHAPTER-SPACE CONVERSION — series-wide, and the coordinator's mid-task rule needs one amendment. dragonquest.fandom's per-episode '|adapted=' numbers are ONE LOW against our space for our ch 123-207 (it does not number the 番外編「勇者アバン」, our slot 122), so anchors in that window are fandom+1 — this sub-block applies it to eps 54, 55, 56 and the opening of ep 57. But the offset is NOT uniform: the fandom gains one number back at our ch 208 (it numbers v22's unnumbered extra 大魔宮の秘密 as its 207), so from our 208 to 349 its numbers ARE ours and eps 58, 59 take them unchanged. The arithmetic is decisive on the fandom's own data: its ep 53-100 fields are strictly contiguous, 187 through 349, 163 numbers for our 162 chapters 188-349 — a uniform +1 sends the finale to a ch 350 that does not exist. Sub-blocks covering our ch 123-207 (roughly ep 35 through ep 57) must convert; anything above ch 208 must not. If sibling verdicts in this wave were re-based on a uniform +1 after the correction, the rows past ch 208 are now one HIGH and need backing out before apply.

The seam's LOCATION (our 207/208) rests on two legs I could cite and one I inferred: the surplus is proven arithmetically and the boundary is proven by Toei's ep 57/58 synopses; the CAUSE — the fandom numbering v22's unnumbered 大魔宮の秘密 as its 207 — is the only candidate left in our list (the other three unnumbered extras are the v13 side story and two v18 info pages, all excluded) but no source states it. I deliberately did NOT put 大魔宮の秘密 into ep 57's chapters_adapted for that reason. A one-line series ruling on the chapter space would stop this being re-derived every wave.

en-WP and MangaDex place the 番外編 differently (en-WP: slot 122, the end of v13; MangaDex: 118, shifting 119-122 up). Our stored table and the fandom both follow en-WP there, so eps ~33-35 are safe — but a verdict citing MangaDex numbers for our ch 118-121 would be one HIGH. Above ch 122 all three agree.

The fandom's own ep-85/86/87 fields carry a real reorder around chs 299-301 (85: '294, 295, 296, 299p, 300p'; 86: '297, 298, 299p, 300p, 301p'; 87: '299p, 301, 302, 303, 304p').
